_meta.description: E-commerce sessions with two planted leakage features. conversion_score is derived from the target (0.75-1.0 for converted=True, 0.0-0.35 for False; point-biserial r=0.894). order_id is a post-event proxy that only exists when converted=True (conditional_null_pct: True=0%, False=100%). Both must be flagged as critical leakage.
planted_leakage: conversion_score: float [0.75-1.0] when converted=True, [0.0-0.35] when False — direct leakage (r=0.894)
order_id: non-null only for converted=True (proxy — post-event artifact)

required_findings.note: correlation_with_target ≈ 0.894 — this is almost certainly a downstream score derived from the target. Critical leakage; must be removed.
conditional_null_pct: {True: 0%, False: 100%} — order_id only exists after a conversion happens. Classic post-event proxy leakage.

forbidden_findings.note: page_views is a pre-event feature — known before any conversion decision. Info-level at most.
cart_value is a pre-event feature. High cart value predicts conversion legitimately.
time_on_site is a pre-event engagement metric. Legitimate predictor.

note_on_max: Two planted leakage features. A few legitimate features might get info-level notes. More than 5 findings suggests noise.
